source_span.text: The Kayenne program is seeking a Cyber Security Engineer technical lead for the Program’s Cyber Team. This team is responsible for applying an interdisciplinary, collaborative approach to plan, design, develop, validate and verify Cyber solutions across the lifecycle.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Lead the Program’s Cyber Team in planning, designing, developing, validating, and verifying Cyber solutions across the lifecycle.

source_span.text: The desired candidate will be able to conduct cyber risk assessment activities including threat modeling, vulnerability analysis and analysis of mitigation solutions.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Conduct cyber risk assessment activities including threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, and analysis of mitigation solutions.

source_span.text: They will also evaluate and analyze design constrains, trade-offs and detailed system and security design as they pertain to the Cyber domain.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Evaluate and analyze design constraints, trade-offs, and detailed system and security design related to the Cyber domain.

source_span.text: Furthermore, they will conduct cybersecurity test and evaluation of hardware and/or software designs to verify and validate compliance with defined specifications and requirements, and employ cyber security processes, methods, techniques and tools and assure their consistent application.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Conduct cybersecurity test and evaluation of hardware and/or software designs to verify and validate compliance with specifications and requirements.

source_span.text: Finally, they will implement appropriate Assessment and Authorization activities as required by customers.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Implement Assessment and Authorization activities as required by customers.

source_span.text: As the Cyber System Security Engineer, you will work with multiple teams across the Kayenne program in an Agile team environment. You will interface with our Operations, Development, Deployment, and Systems Engineering teams, and will help to derive innovative solutions to complex technical problems to provide our customers with a secure system and new capabilities. In addition, you will interface and collaborate cross-functionally with government personnel, customer partners, subcontractors, local engineers, and geographically dispersed teammates.

responsibilities.responsibility_description: Collaborate cross-functionally with multiple teams and external partners to provide secure systems and new capabilities.

source_span.text: In this role, you will also perform the following: • POA&M Workoff Plan & Execution • EVSS Admin/System Vulnerability Audit/Analysis/Compliance/Remediation • Body of Evidence (BoE) Definition for customer assets as driven by change requests • Demonstration Test Plan (DTP) definition and execution • System Change Request and Software Build Technical Investigations • New and Version Upgraded COTS/GOTS Software Review and Security Risk assessment • Daily System Audit Analysis and Log Review • IATT/CONOPS definitions and approvals • Security Design and Architecture • STIG Hardening Guidance • Security Test Definition, Execution, and Gov. Witness Testing and Test Report Generation • Govt. Audit Support • Security Tool Design and System integration Support
